events.description: Called when a list row or a card is pressed, for example to open the record.
events.name: onItemPress

events.description: Web: saves the grid view's edited cells; given, the grid is offered. Its columns are the engine's.
events.name: onGridSave

events.description: Shares a saved view; given, the views menu has "Share view".
events.name: onShareView

events.description: Fetches the rows again; defaults to the engine's own refresh in server mode, and no Refresh otherwise.
events.name: onRefresh

events.description:
Given, each row gets a drag handle (pointer, keyboard and screen reader, through React Aria's drag and drop) and a
drop calls this with the rows shown in their new order (group and total rows left out). Nothing moves until the
app passes the rows back; reordering a sorted view is the app's call.
events.name: onReorder

events.description: Called with the ids of the expanded rows after a row or "expand all" is pressed.
events.name: onExpandedChange

events.description: Called when a row is opened: a press on the row (Enter from the keyboard).
events.name: onRowOpen

events.description:
Called with a valid edited value of a column marked `isEditable` (its `type` picks the DataGrid editor, its rules
validate the value); the app writes the row. A returned promise is awaited: a rejection is shown on the cell.
events.name: onCellEdit
events.type: (item: TItem, columnId: string, value: DataGridValue) => void | Promise<void>

props.description: The name of the records, for example "Orders": the table's name and the toolbar's.
props.name: label

props.description: How many rows can be selected in the table. Defaults to `none`, or `multiple` with `bulkActions`.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: What a list row shows.
props.name: list

props.description: The engine every view draws from (`useCollection`).
props.name: collection

props.description: The content of a table cell; left out, the column's text.
props.name: renderCell

props.description: What shows when there are no rows at all.
props.name: emptyState

props.description: The actions of one row, in the table's row menu.
props.name: rowActions

props.description: The actions on the selection, in the bulk bar.
props.name: bulkActions

props.description: What a card shows.
props.name: cards

props.description:
The views offered by the switcher, in order. Defaults to table, list and cards, with grid when `onGridSave` is
given (web) and board when `board` is (web); native offers list and cards.
props.name: layouts

props.description: The view a phone opens on when the engine was never switched: `list` (the default) or `cards`.
props.name: phoneLayout

props.description: The export dialog's options; given, the toolbar has Export. The counts default to the engine's.
props.name: exportOptions

props.description: False to leave out the full-screen button. Defaults to true on web.
props.name: hasFullscreen

props.description: Draws a view the component does not (the board of wave 4), or replaces one, by layout.
props.name: renderLayout

props.description:
True to draw the row actions that have an icon as buttons revealed on hover or keyboard focus, beside the row
menu, which still lists them all.
props.name: hasHoverActions

props.description: False to leave the browser's own menu on a right-click; by default a row's right-click (or Shift+F10) opens its actions.
props.name: hasContextMenu

props.description: Given, each row gets a disclosure button and an expanded row shows this under it across every column.
props.name: renderRowDetail

props.description: The ids of the expanded rows, for a controlled expansion.
props.name: expandedKeys

props.description: The ids of the rows expanded at first.
props.name: defaultExpandedKeys

props.description: Given, an opened row shows this in a resizable side panel beside the table (a drawer on a small screen).
props.name: renderRowPanel

props.description: True to draw only the rows, cards or board cards in view (React Aria's Virtualizer), for 10,000 rows and more.
props.name: isVirtualized

props.description:
The DataView's own width, in CSS pixels, under which the table view is drawn as cards (the engine's layout stays
`table`, so a wider frame shows the table again). Defaults to 600; `null` keeps the table at any width.
props.name: cardsBelow

props.description: Given, the view switcher offers the Board: cards in columns by one field, moved by drag or from a menu.
props.name: board

props.description: The records' name, for the builder's accessible name.
